title: CHAOS Contract Record
description: The change contract as data: testable statements with stable ids (records/contract.json). Written at FRAME; later phases may amend it under stable ids (addedBy records who). Deliberately carries NO checkbox state and NO evidence - ticking is a render-time join against the latest deliver-pass coverage, which is what makes 'DELIVER ticks it only when covered by a test or a directly-evidenced check' a mechanical rule and current.contract a derived count that cannot go stale.

groups.description: Render order of statement groups. A statement whose group is not listed here is a validation error (checked in code, not expressible in-schema).

source.description: Decision entries that shaped this statement; validated against the ledger.

addedBy.description: Set when a phase after FRAME added this statement (e.g. a review remediation).
